guide: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art character sprite sheet for a professional Peruvian mathematics game for children aged 7-8. Friendly young Peruvian woman carpenter guide, medium brown skin, dark braided hair, cream shirt, turquoise work apron with a pocket, dark trousers and practical shoes. Holding a small wooden toy house model. Exactly four equal cells in ONE horizontal row, full body in every cell at identical scale and feet baseline. Frame 1 calm friendly idle holding toy; frame 2 raises a hand to encourage; frame 3 celebrates with open palm and smile; frame 4 relaxed smile holding toy. Distinct natural arm poses, consistent face and outfit across all frames, no extra objects or characters. Polished crisp pixel clusters, teal outlines, warm amber light, terracotta highlights, clear silhouette at 120 px screen height. True transparent background with wide clear gutters; no words, numerals, text, grid, borders or backdrop. Wide 3:1 composition.
workbench: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished pixel-art background for a children's geometric construction puzzle board. Top-down view of a handcrafted light honey-colored wooden workshop tabletop, broad smooth EMPTY cream wood center occupying 80 percent of the image, subtle fine grain with very low contrast so geometric puzzle pieces stay readable. A sturdy bevelled wooden frame around the outside with warm terracotta corner joins, one small pencil and rolled blank plan tucked at extreme upper left, a small leaf and wood shavings only at extreme lower right. Inviting warm daylight from upper left. Teal and terracotta accents only on the outer rim. Professional crisp pixel art matching a Peruvian community craft workshop, no characters, no shapes, no holes, no writing, no numerals, no UI, no painted graph, no strong lines or objects in the central work area. Landscape 3:2 composition, edge-to-edge opaque background.
